tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye rañño na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā paccantime vā janapade anusaññātuṃ.
jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
sampajānamusāvādo kho pan'āyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddh'āpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hi'ssa phāsu hoti.
vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.
samet'āyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti

so, n'ātisupakko maccho mayhaṃ aphāsukam'akāsi, bhante'ti. āvuso, tuyhaṃ phāsukena vā aphāsukena vā kammaṃ n'atthi, āpattiṃ āpanno'sī'ti. bhante, yāva tattha vasiṃ, tāva me aphāsukam'eva jātan'ti.
idha yassa te honti aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā dhammā, ye vā pan'assa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukakāmā ayogakkhemakāmā

yasmiṃ, ānanda, samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati, phāsutaro, ānanda, tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa kāyo hoti.

47729.meaning1: fact of being easy; fact of being comfortable; pleasantness

47733.meaning1: time when living at ease; occasion of living comfortably

seyyathā'pi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evam'ev'assu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

asu hi, bhante, sālalaṭṭhi bahiddhā suparikammakatā, anto suvisuddhā nāvākatā phiy'ārittabaddhā. tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, nāvā na saṃsīdissati, puriso sotthinā pāraṃ gamissatī'ti.

evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti? evaṃ, bhante, ayaṃ nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā'ti.

47746.synonym: anugata, ophuṭa, parigata, paripūra, paribhāvita, pareta, byāpita
47746.commentary: (DHPa) manasā ca phuṭo siyā'ti heṭṭhimehi tīhi maggaphalacittehi phuṭo pūrito bhaveyya.

examples.text: chandajāto anakkhāte, manasā ca phuṭo siyā, kāmesu ca appaṭibaddhacitto, uddhaṃsoto'ti vuccati.
s'āyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sneh'ānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca pagghariṇī

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo. so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti.
phuṭṭho, bhikkhave, vedeti, phuṭṭho ceteti, phuṭṭho sañjānāti. itth'ete'pi dhammā calā c'eva byathā ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino.
seyyo na tena maññeyya, nīceyyo athavā'pi sarikkho, phuṭṭho anekarūpehi, n'ātumānaṃ vikappayaṃ tiṭṭhe.
eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇḍakena nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho. so yena yena icchati tena tena gacchati. yattha yattha icchati tattha tattha tiṭṭhati.

47751.commentary: (ITIa) phuṭṭho vimokkho manasā, santipadam'anuttaran'ti yasmā sabbasaṅkhatavimuttattā vimokkho'ti sabbakilesa-santāpa-vūpasamana-ṭṭhānatāya santipadan'ti laddhanāmo nibbānadhammo phuṭṭho phusito patto, tasmā akkhātāraṃ na maññatī'ti.

examples.text: akkheyyañ'ca pariññāya, akkhātāraṃ na maññati, phuṭṭho vimokkho manasā, santipadam'anuttaraṃ.
chandajātā avasāyī, manasā ca phuṭṭhā siyā, kāmesu appaṭibaddhacittā, uddhaṃsotā vimuccatī'ti.

47752.meaning1: fact of being touched; fact of being experienced; fact of being permeated (by)

47754.commentary: (VINa) tattha yañ'ca vuttaṃ, āmasanā nāma āmaṭṭhamattā'ti yañ'ca, chupanaṃ nāma phuṭṭhamattan'ti, imesaṃ ayaṃ viseso, āmasanā'ti āmajjanā phuṭṭh'okāsaṃ anatikkamitvā'pi tatth'eva saṅghaṭṭanā. ayañ'hi āmaṭṭhamattā'ti vuccati. chupanan'ti asaṅghaṭṭetvā phuṭṭhamattaṃ.

47759.meaning1: in full bloom and full of fragrance

47762.synonym: chupati, paṭisaṃvediyati, phasseti, vedayati, vediyati, vedeti

examples.text: gāme araññe sukhadukkhaphuṭṭho, n'ev'attato no parato dahetha, phusanti phassā upadhiṃ paṭicca, nirūpadhiṃ kena phuseyyu phassā'ti.
phasso nu lokasmi kutonidāno, pariggahā c'āpi kutopahūtā, kismiṃ asante na mamattam'atthi, kismiṃ vibhūte na phusanti phassā.

47763.commentary: (SNa) n'āphusantaṃ phusatī'ti kammaṃ aphusantaṃ vipāko na phusati, kammam'eva vā aphusantaṃ kammaṃ na phusati. kammañ'hi n'ākaroto kariyati. (SNa) tam'eva bālaṃ phusatī'ti taṃ'y'eva bālaṃ idhalokaparalokesu jighacchā ca pipāsā ca phusati anubandhati na vijahati.

examples.text: m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.
n'āphusantaṃ phusati ca, phusantañ'ca tato phuse, tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti.

47764.meaning1: (of meditation attainments or Nibbāna) experiences; reaches; attains; achieves
47764.synonym: adhigacchati, appeti, āpajjati, pappoti, pāpuṇāti, phassayati, phussayati

examples.text: bhāvehi jhānāni ca indriyāni ca, balāni bojjh'aṅgasamādhibhāvanā, tisso ca vijjā phusa buddhasāsane, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.
so abhijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, parijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, pajahanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, sacchikaronto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sammāvimuttiṃ phusati.

47765.commentary: (VINa) yo gām'antaṃ osareyya vajjaṃ naṃ phuseyyā'ti yo ekabhikkhu'pi araññaṃ pahāya nivās'atthāya gām'antaṃ osareyya, vajjaṃ taṃ phuseyya naṃ bhikkhuṃ doso phusatu, āpattiyā naṃ bhagavā kāretū'ti adhippāyena vadati.

examples.text: yath'āssa phusato phassaṃ, sevato c'āpi vedanaṃ, khīyati n'opacīyati, evaṃ so caratī sato, evaṃ apacinato dukkhaṃ, santike nibbānam'uccati.

47770.commentary: (SNa) phusantañ'ca tato phuse'ti kammaṃ phusantaṃ vipāko phusati, kammam'eva vā phusati. kammañ'hi karoto kariyati.

examples.text: n'āphusantaṃ phusati ca, phusantañ'ca tato phuse, tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti.

47773.meaning1: causes to rain on; makes sprinkle; causes to shower

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, sādhu khv'assa, bhante thera, sītako ca vāto vāyeyya, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusāyeyyā'ti.
pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.
te pabbajitvā sugatassa sāsane, bhāvetva bojjh'aṅgabalāni paṇḍitā, udaggacittā sumanā kat'indriyā, phusiṃsu nibbānapadaṃ asaṅkhatan'ti.
atha kho āyasmā mahako tathārūpaṃ iddh'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhari yathā sītako ca vāto vāyi, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusi.
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti
seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭ'āgāraṃ ullitt'āvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusita-aggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ

47778.commentary: (THa) phusitaṃ vā hānabhāgiyaṃ ṭhitibhāgiyam'eva vā ahutvā yathā visesabhāgiyaṃ hoti, tathā anurakkhituṃ pāletuṃ sukaraṃ, tathā na sukaraṃ, tathā sampādetuṃ na sakkā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ nānappayātamhi, na dāni sukaraṃ tathā. aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ, phusitaṃ v'ānurakkhituṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, uparipabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandarapadarasākhā paripūreti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakabubbuḷaṃ uppajjati c'eva nirujjhati ca.
seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭ'āgāraṃ ullitt'āvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phusit'aggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ
kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde, gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme, ādittato'haṃ samathehi yutto, paññāya dacchaṃ tadidaṃ kadā me.

47782.meaning1: to experience; to reach; to attain; to achieve

examples.text: evaṃ nānappayātamhi, na dāni sukaraṃ tathā, aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ, phusitaṃ v'ānurakkhituṃ.
puna caparaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhuno kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā uppajjati manāpaṃ, uppajjati amanāpaṃ, uppajjati manāp'āmanāpaṃ
kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā piyarūpe phoṭṭhabbe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe phoṭṭhabbe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati parittacetaso.

47784.meaning1: having come into contact; having experienced (something with)
47784.commentary: (SNa) na ca kāyena phusitvā'ti udakaṃ pana nīharitvā kāyena phusitvā viharituṃ na sakkuṇeyya. udapāne udakadassanaṃ viya hi anāgāmino nibbānadassanaṃ, ghamm'ābhitattapuriso viya anāgāmī, udakavārako viya arahattamaggo, yathā ghamm'ābhitattapuriso udapāne udakaṃ passati. evaṃ anāgāmī paccavekkhaṇañāṇena upari arahattaphalasamayo nāma atthī'ti jānāti. yathā pana so puriso udakavārakassa n'atthitāya udakaṃ nīharitvā kāyena phusituṃ na labhati, evaṃ anāgāmī arahattamaggassa n'atthitāya nibbānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā arahattaphalasamāpattiṃ appetvā nisīdituṃ na labhati.

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito, so taṃ udapānaṃ olokeyya. tassa udakan'ti hi kho ñāṇaṃ assa, na ca kāyena phusitvā vihareyya. evam'eva kho, āvuso, bhavanirodho nibbānan'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ, na c'amhi arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo'ti.

47785.meaning1: having reached; having attained; having experienced
47785.synonym: anupāpuṇitvā, upagantvā, pāpuṇitvā, pāpuṇitvāna, phassayitvā, phusayitvā, phussayitvā
47785.commentary: (MNa) kāyena phusitvā'ti nāmakāyena phusitvā pāpuṇitvā, adhigantvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te na kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā ekacce āsavā parikkhīṇā honti
tattha tattha vipassitvā, phusitvā accutaṃ padaṃ, kat'antaṃ paccavekkhantā, imam'attham'abhāsisuṃ.
pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.

47788.meaning1: could be felt; tangible; can be physically touched

examples.text: ye te kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā asamphuṭṭhā asamphuṭṭhapubbā, na ca phusasi, na ca te hoti phuseyyan'ti? atthi te tattha chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

47789.grammar: opt 3rd pl of phuseyya, irreg form of phuseyyuṃ, trans (+acc)
47789.meaning1: they could affect; they could befall; they could harm; they could impact
47789.construction:
phusa + eyya + um
phuseyya + u(ṃ) > phuseyyu

examples.text: gāme araññe sukhadukkhaphuṭṭho, n'ev'attato no parato dahetha, phusanti phassā upadhiṃ paṭicca, nirūpadhiṃ kena phuseyyu phassā'ti.
m'āvoca pharusaṃ kañci, vuttā paṭivadeyyu taṃ, dukkhā hi sārambhakathā, paṭidaṇḍā phuseyyu taṃ.

47790.meaning1: touching again and again; repeatedly coming into contact with

examples.text: etaṃ dukkhan'ti ñatvāna, mosadhammaṃ palokinaṃ, phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha vijānati, vedanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
so navañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, purāṇañ'ca kammaṃ phussa phussa byantīkaroti, sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opaneyyikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhi.
etaṃ dukkhan'ti ñatvāna, mosadhammaṃ palokinaṃ, phussa phussa vayaṃ passaṃ, evaṃ tattha vijānati, vedanānaṃ khayā bhikkhu, nicchāto parinibbuto'ti.
phassaṃ phussa sati muṭṭhā, piyaṃ nimittaṃ manasi karoto, sārattacitto vedeti, tañ'ca ajjhosa tiṭṭhati.

47792.meaning1: name of a lunar month; December-January
47792.commentary: (VISMa) so pana vassāno utu sāvaṇapoṭṭhapādamāsā, assayujakattikamāsā sarado, migasiraphussamāsā hemanto, māghaphaggunamāsā sisiro, cittavesākhamāsā vasanto, jeṭṭh'āsaḷhamāsā gimho utū'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: so pana vassāno utu sāvaṇapoṭṭhapādamāsā, assayujakattikamāsā sarado, māgasiraphussamāsā hemanto, māghaphaggunamāsā sisiro, cittavesākhamāsā vasanto, jeṭṭh'āsaḷhamāsā gimho utū'ti veditabbo.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso sarabha, ambukasañcarī phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravati, evam'evaṃ kho tvaṃ, āvuso sarabha, aññatr'eva samaṇena gotamena phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti, ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravasi.

47796.meaning1: cuckoo's cry; call of the cuckoo
47796.commentary: (ANa) purisakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti mahākukkuṭaṃ ravantaṃ disvā imassa'pi dve pādā dve pakkhā, mayham'pi tath'eva, aham'pi evarūpaṃ ravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti sā tassa sammukhā ravituṃ asakkontī tasmiṃ pakkante ravamānā kukkuṭikāravaṃ'y'eva ravi. tena vuttaṃ, ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravatī'ti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso sarabha, ambukasañcarī phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravati, evam'evaṃ kho tvaṃ, āvuso sarabha, aññatr'eva samaṇena gotamena phussakaravitaṃ ravissāmī'ti, ambukasañcariravitaṃ'y'eva ravasi.
jātassa maraṇaṃ hoti, jāto dukkhāni phussati, bandhaṃ vadhaṃ pariklesaṃ, tasmā jātiṃ na rocaye.

47799.meaning2: state carriage (running of its own accord in order to find an heir to a throne)
